$description: Mac OS 9 Platinum cross-project design tokens (W3C DTCG format). Neutral R=G=B metallic chassis with official Gray (default) and Lavender accent variants.

font-ui.$description: Fast CJK-safe UI font stack led by classic Mac OS 9 Charcoal/Lucida Grande.

font-mono.$value: "Monaco", "SF Mono", "Cascadia Mono", "Consolas", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei UI", "Noto Sans CJK SC", ui-monospace, monospace
font-mono.$description: Crisp monospace font stack for code windows, keycaps, and raw inspection.

size-control.$description: Default push button, menu, and compact label size.

size-body.$description: Standard form input, list row, and dialog copy.

size-title.$description: Group box and section heading size.

window.$description: Sharp 0px corners on windows, menus, panels, cards, Wells, and badges.

sm.$description: 2px micro-corner for compact 20px icon buttons and keycaps.

control.$description: 3px corner for standalone push buttons and select pop-up triggers.

compact.$description: Default Platinum density: crisp, compact desktop proportions without bloated 3D borders.

comfortable.$description: Opt-in comfortable density for form-heavy settings surfaces (data-platinum-density="comfortable").

chassis.$description: Zero-cast neutral R=G=B metallic chassis shared by all accent variants.

window.$description: Window chrome, dialog body, and sidebar surface.

face.$description: Raised push button, toolbar, and table header surface.

face-hover.$description: Hovered button and elevated subtle card surface.

pressed-bg.$description: Depressed button and active segment fill.

paper.$description: Sunken content well, document paper, and text input fill.

code-bg.$description: Code window interior and subtle blockquote fill.

ink-muted.$description: Secondary text (>= 5.25:1 across paper, window, face, and face-hover).

frame.$description: Crisp 1px structural border for windows, buttons, and wells.

danger.$description: Destructive text/border (>= 6.0:1 across all light surfaces).

success.$description: Confirmation text/indicator (>= 4.96:1 across all light surfaces).

warning.$description: Caution text (>= 5.5:1 across all light surfaces and #ffffcc).

warning-soft.$description: Classic Mac OS Balloon Help pale amber fill.

gray.$description: Default product Gray palette: purple-free silver scrollbars, neutral selection, and deep slate focus/links.

lavender.$description: Product variant inspired by the sampled Mac OS 9.0 Lavender variation (data-platinum-accent="lavender"): lavender selection & four-ridge scrollbar, deep indigo focus/menus.
